violations.message: In the 3D top and iso views the relay bodies K1-K4 abut the screw terminal bodies J1-J4 with no visible assembly gap, and the SMD driver passives sit nearly touching the top edges of the relay bodies.

In the 2D view the driver-cluster designators overlap each other and their pads (e.g. 'R R5', 'Q1 D1' rendered on top of the dense pad clusters), and the right-side L2/C2/C1/L1 labels sit directly on the components in that tightly stacked column.

The entire top third of the board and wide left/right margins are empty while the driver clusters are congested to near-touching, and the L2/C2/C1/L1 column is stranded at the far right away from any functional group.
C1 and C2 sit in a stranded vertical column at the right board edge with L1/L2, well away from the +5V_RELAY coil supply pins they serve and not immediately adjacent to any load pin.

No power-entry point or input->filter->load ordering is discernible: L1/L2/C1/C2 are stacked in an arbitrary right-edge column far from the relay coil loads they feed, so the +5V_RELAY distribution placement does not read as a power chain.

violations.message: In the 3D top and iso views the THT relay bodies K1-K4 abut the screw terminal bodies J1-J4 with no visible assembly gap, and the right-side L1/C1/C2/L2 passives are stacked nearly touching in a vertical column.

In the 2D view the driver-cluster designators overlap each other and their pads (e.g. 'R R5' and 'Q1 D1' rendered directly over the dense pad clusters), and the L2/C2/C1/L1 labels sit on top of the tightly stacked right-side column.

Roughly the top third of the board plus wide left and right margins are completely empty while all parts are compressed into the lower-middle band, and the L2/C2/C1/L1 strip is stranded at the far right away from any functional group.

The only capacitors C1/C2 sit crammed in a right-edge column overlapping L1/L2, several cm from the +5V_RELAY coil pins they serve and not immediately adjacent to any power pin (no ICs exist to decouple).

No power-entry connector exists and the +5V filter parts L1/C1/L2/C2 are stacked in an arbitrary overlapping right-edge column with long ratsnest reaches to the relay coil rail, so no input -> filter -> load placement order is discernible.
